decls.description: Whether the regulation counts a cost towards the subsidy (article 3).
What the whole number of a parameter counts.
An article of the Energy-Saving Subsidy Regulation 2026. Origin: the regulation as published.

An amount or rate of the scheme, valid from a date until (exclusive) another. Origin: the decision that set it, under the article that uses it. A new value is a new row, never an edit. The decision is a Decision of the standard pack std-decision: who took it, when, from when it applies and how it stands are its slots, and its rules say whether it is in force on a reference date. A decided value (plane: control): a new row comes only from a reviewed proposal, which the policy adviser reviews.

slots.description: The name a calculation rule reads. Of the rows with one name, the row valid on the evaluation date is chosen.
The calendar its two dates are days of.

decls.description: A calendar whose days the scheme counts: the axis on which a validity and a reference day are compared (std-time reads it as its Axis, views.yaml). Origin: a design choice of this example. The regulation dates everything by the civil calendar, so the pack has one.

The reference date of the scheme, with what std-time needs to read validity at it (views.yaml reads it as a ReferencePoint): the calendar its day is a day of, and how far ahead an end counts as near. The same element as the ReferenceDate of std-decision, never a second day. Origin: a design choice of this example, as the reference date is.

slots.description: The number of days ahead of the day within which the end of a validity counts as near. Origin: a design choice of this example: the council sets the amounts of the next year in the last quarter, so an amount that ends within ninety days is one to decide about now.

decls.description: A kind of cost a quote can name. Origin: the regulation, which lists the measures that count and the costs that do not (article 3).
A household that applies. Origin: an observation, the population register as consulted for the application.
An application for the subsidy. Origin: an observation, the application form as received.

slots.description: The total cost the applicant states on the form.

decls.description: One line of a quote submitted with an application. Origin: an observation, the quote as received. An application without any line has no quote yet: its costs are unknown, not zero.
The verified yearly income of a household. Origin: an observation, the statement of the income register. Open world: a household without a statement has an unknown income, never an income of zero.
A registered energy-advice report for a household. Origin: an observation, the advice register. Closed world: the register is complete, so a household without a report took no advice.

module.description: A municipal energy-saving subsidy scheme, entirely synthetic: the regulation and the decisions that set its amounts, households and their applications with quoted costs, and the registers a case officer consults. The award follows from these by rules (rules/, calc/); nothing here stores it.
